tasks.title: Credits line, dark mode, header
tasks.request: A permanent footer with my GitHub, LinkedIn and the repo; a light/dark switch at the top right with the language options next to it; the same look in Hebrew
tasks.summary: A quiet credits line under every screen, a moon/sun toggle and the language switch together at the top right, with Start over leaving the welcome header. Picked from four mockups and live on 2026-11-04.

items.note: Carries the header's right-hand group and the credits line, and applies a saved theme before the first paint so the page never flashes the wrong colors.
Switches and saves the theme, paints the moon or sun, and refreshes the toggle label with the language on every screen change.
The header's tools group, the round toggle and the credits line, pinned left-to-right and to one font so Hebrew looks the same.
The page fills the phone so the credits line can sit at the bottom; Start over leaves the welcome header instead of hiding in place.
Two new words in every language: Dark mode, Light mode. The credits line is not translated.
Wires the toggle and keeps its icon in step with the phone's setting.
Checks the header group, the toggle (reload, Start over, no storage, a dark phone) and the credits line in every language.
Allows every screen the credits line's height and checks the line is there.
Takes the three phone screenshots the new README shows.

tasks.title: Language from the phone
tasks.request: Set the app language by the browser locale
tasks.summary: With nothing saved the app opens in the phone's language when it is Hebrew or Polish, else English, and keeps following the phone until the switch is tapped.

items.note: Reads the phone's language list and applies a language without saving it; only the switch saves.
Starts from the saved choice, else the phone's language.
Opens the app as a Hebrew, Polish, German and British phone and checks the language, that nothing is saved, and that a tap wins.
